]> 28/07/2026 7:07 Snow in the forecast!.

After a string of blue-sky, sunny days, a cool change has arrived at Perisher. Today is looking to be a cloudy day with a top of 3 degrees, with a chance of snow showers in the latter half of the day and into the evening. Winds will continue to build as the day goes on, reaching north-westerly 55 to 75 km/h. Visibility on the slopes will be impacted with the overcast conditions, so please take care when skiing and boarding.

There are 29 lifts expected to spin today, however please note that strong winds may have an impact on lift operations. Be sure to keep an eye on the lift report for real-time updates, or download the Perisher App to stay in the loop.

It's currently -3 degrees at Perisher, and last night the snowmaking team were able to fire up the guns, with 160 snow guns running from 6:00pm and still going this morning. Conditions on the slopes are hard-packed, topped with a layer of man-made snow, so expect firm and fast conditions underfoot.

Off the slopes, catch the live music at Jax Bar, where indie soul musician Will Clift is playing from 3:00pm.

Looking ahead, there's snow in the forecast for tonight and tomorrow - let's see what Mother Nature delivers!
